programme.title: White Apache
programme.desc: Outlaws attack a band of settlers and kill everyone except a pregnant woman who's rescued by a band of Indians. The woman dies giving birth but Chief White Bear adopts her male baby, naming him "Shining Sky," and raising him as brother to his own son, Black Wolf.

programme.title: Hitch-Hike
programme.desc: Walter and Eve, a young married couple in crisis, set off on a trip through the California woods in an attempt to save their marriage. On the way back, the two offer a hitchhiker a lift: he is a bandit on the run, fresh from a bank robbery, but by the time the couple realise the situation, it is already too late.

programme.title: The Inglorious Bastards
programme.desc: The cult film that inspired Tarantino. Two men form an unusual friendship in an attempt to avoid death during World War II.

programme.title: Who Finds a Friend Finds a Treasure
programme.desc: Alan, a gambler, drains his uncle's savings and takes refuge on Charlie's boat, on a cruise. They shipwreck on an island, defend a tribe from pirates and discover a Japanese fort with treasure. In the end, the money turns out to be fake and Alan forgets a diamond idol, later exhibited in a museum where they are both hired as labourers.

programme.title: Getaway of Love
programme.desc: Giuliana leads a normal life; she has been married for 10 years to Martino, a less-than-passionate husband more devoted to his employment than to her. One day two thugs break into the supermarket where she works. A handsome policeman, Leonardo, comes to stop the robbery. A boundless attraction arises between the two, which will lead them to extreme choices in order to stay together.
